method: Unresolved-site sweep of current source objects. Each admitted text operand has a unique contiguous instruction context with an independent established reference, matching non-reference operands, injective local-byte mapping and branch checks. Original English payloads are checked in the corresponding pinned NWC function. Russian comes directly from Buka CP1251 bytes. Suspicious campaign-loss and town asset associations are withheld for wider CFG review. Catalog substitutions preserve the source expressions and control flow.

special_save_names.method: All standalone source occurrences in GAME and KB are reviewed and converted together; comparisons, callers and generated names use the same locale-selected IDs.

removed_stale_nwc_state.name: ?gEventMusicVolume@@3HA
removed_stale_nwc_state.evidence: Buka event code no longer parks/restores the old music-volume scalar (buka-events.json). Its unreferenced NWC declaration retained an invalid address claim over the NextPlayer autosave filename. The actual Buka target contains the complete CP1251 autosave literal; the old i32(-1) initializer contradicts it. Remove the stale unused declaration and claim. No runtime event logic is changed.

compiled_literal_controls.method: Every admitted complete CP1251 string is referenced by the corresponding current compiled function. This validates payload presence, not whole-function equivalence. Original English and formatting signatures are checked against the catalog.

dialog_conjunction_allocation.method: Retail and compiled allocation/copy instruction sequences agree, including strlen + 1, malloc, strcpy, reference payloads and consistent local storage.
